description: This file contains unit tests for the tracing system in a C++ project, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests trace data parsing, buffer handling, and tracing functionalities including categories and logging, with specific focus on the 'test_tracing.cpp' context.

classes.name: ServerCyclicBuffer01
classes.description: A custom cyclic buffer class for testing, inheriting from CyclicBuffer, with overridden GetReadSize method.

methods.name: ReadTraceString
methods.description: Reads a null-terminated string from a byte buffer starting at a given offset.

methods.name: ParseTraceData
methods.description: Parses trace data from a byte buffer into a TraceData structure, extracting header, file, module, category, class, and text fields.

methods.name: DebugCheckIfConsistent
methods.description: Checks the consistency of trace buffer entries, verifying each entry's size and total length.

methods.name: CreateTraceBuffer
methods.description: Creates a directory for trace buffer files.
